name: Norman PD Incident Data Pipeline and Visualization
description: Automated data pipeline extracting Norman PD incident reports from PDFs, geocoding locations using Google Maps API, determining geographic distribution, and integrating historical weather data. Features Streamlit visualization dashboard for analyzing incident patterns by time, location, and weather conditions to support public safety resource allocation.

name: Feedback Nexus
description: Anonymous feedback platform with AI-powered insights and real-time analytics. Features customizable surveys, personalized dashboards, unique sharing links, and OpenAI integration for message generation. Built with Next.js, MongoDB, NextAuth authentication, and Recharts visualization. Perfect for educators, HR professionals, and event organizers seeking honest, constructive feedback with complete anonymity.

name: GatorLibrary Management System
description: Library management system using Red-Black Trees for book operations and Binary Min-Heaps for reservations, achieving O(log n) time complexity. Features include book insertion/deletion, borrowing/returning, reservation prioritization, and closest book search. Implements self-balancing tree algorithms with rotation, deletion, and color flip tracking for optimal performance.

name: NLP-Healers: SDoH Extraction from Clinical Notes
description: Evaluated language models (GPT-2, GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4 Turbo, Gemma 7B) for extracting Social Determinants of Health from electronic health records. Fine-tuned GPT-2 achieved 85.56% accuracy on SDoH labels and 91.11% on adverse labels, demonstrating NLP's potential in healthcare data extraction and improving healthcare equity through advanced clinical narrative analysis.

name: Social13 - Student Housing Platform
description: Student-centric housing search platform for Gainesville designed to simplify apartment hunting for university students. Built with React and Create React App, featuring intuitive property listings, search functionality, and seamless browsing experience. Deployed on Netlify for reliable hosting, helping students find their perfect home effortlessly through a modern, responsive web interface.

name: DeepFakeNet: Deepfake Detection System
description: Advanced deepfake detection system using DeeperMesoInception4 model on FaceForensics++ dataset. Implements MTCNN for face detection, preprocessing pipeline converting videos to frames, and achieves 82.08% accuracy in identifying manipulated content. Employs Binary Cross-Entropy Loss and Adam optimizer, effectively detecting digital media manipulation across Deepfakes, Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures techniques.
